claims.claim: Added bounded retrieval quality evaluation error, benchmark case, case/report/fidelity immutable values, and evaluator functions with no new retrieval, planner, provider, persistence, ranking, semantic-search, or truth-resolution API.

RetrievalBenchmarkCase strictly validates bounded exact case/question/query values and non-empty unique Human relevant_variant_ids while preserving accepted strings and order without assigning canonical truth semantics.

Lexical evaluation materializes inputs once, rejects invalid/duplicate cases and invalid limit, delegates exactly once per case to TASK-122 with exact corpus/query/limit, propagates TASK-122 failures unchanged, and never reimplements retrieval.

Gold IDs bind only to the validated corpus; each case result retains exact case, limit, and TASK-122 hits, preserves hit order for TP/FP and Human label order for FN, and adds no relevance source beyond explicit benchmark membership.
Per-case and micro precision/recall use exact Fraction arithmetic with specified zero-hit behavior, exact aggregate counts, exact caller case order, and no extra metric policy.

Citation evaluation requires exact question/query/limit and value-equal TASK-122 hit continuity between case evaluation and GroundedAnswer context; unrelated contexts fail closed and evaluation never reruns retrieval/context construction.

Fidelity maps only already-valid leaf citations to parent hit variants, excludes hit headers from its denominator, preserves answer citation order, returns exact relevant/irrelevant leaf tuples, exact Fraction when leaves exist, and None when none exist.

Evaluation never grades answer wording or semantic entailment and keeps Human benchmark relevance distinct from canonical product truth, M2 ranking/approval, TASK-122 retrieval semantics, and TASK-129 structural grounding.

Successful evaluation performs no model/provider/query-planning, persistence/filesystem/SQLite/network/browser/Drive, environment, clock/random/UUID, subprocess, admission, ranking/scoring, evidence mutation, or semantic/vector retrieval work, and predecessor implementation modules remain unchanged.

Focused regressions pass and canonical roadmaps record P6.0 CLOSED after TASK-163, P6.1 CURRENT, TASK-164 as P6.1a, P6.1b as next real-evidence benchmark execution, and P6.2 blocked until reviewed empirical P6.1b evidence exists.
